summary: Practise SQL Server operations, backup validation, and incident diagnosis. Explore the five-day course outline and assess its fit for your role.
lede: SQL Server database administration helps administrators and support staff keep database services configured, secure, and recoverable. You will assess instance settings and permissions, manage and troubleshoot SQL Server Agent jobs, validate backup and restore sequences, and investigate integrity and workload issues using DBCC CHECKDB, Query Store, and Extended Events.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for technical professionals who support SQL Server database services, maintain database workloads, and report operational status or incidents.
prerequisites: Intermediate SQL Server familiarity and working knowledge of relational databases are expected. T-SQL scripting is required for completion; application programming is not required. Bring a laptop with SSMS installed and access to an appropriately licensed SQL Server instance for hands-on exercises.
